words: Love Nov 1 2026 ~3:19 AM PT (this thread): "The desk freezes every time something is off. That is the problem. I cannot see what is wrong if she freezes the second it happens. I cannot fix what I cannot see. Find what is causing the freeze on every turn-on. Fix the freeze so the desk stays on and the skip log still records the reason. The freeze is not allowed to hide the cause."
what: When the spine lock is in drift (recon.ts changed without a re-sign), recon's read returned false BEFORE the skip log ran, so the freeze hid its own cause. This logs the exact drift reason (have vs want, which .command to run) to data/recon-skips.jsonl before it returns, so the cause is never hidden again. The books still hold on drift (that safety is unchanged) - they just say why now.
books: all reconstructed books (the reconLocked() gate at the top of reconTick)
proof: diff = 1 line, additive; transpiles; cornerstones + check-her-rules + behaviour-umpire all still pass on the staged recon (door untouched); umpire SAFE.
